endpoints.description: Convert a street address into latitude/longitude coordinates.
Convert lat/lng coordinates into a human-readable street address.
Get driving, walking, biking, or transit directions. Returns steps, distance, and travel time.
endpoints.params: origin (required), destination (required), key (required), mode (optional: driving/walking/bicycling/transit), waypoints (optional), departure_time (optional), avoid (optional: tolls/highways/ferries)

endpoints.description: Find restaurants, gas stations, hospitals, or any business type near a location.
endpoints.params: location (required, lat,lng), radius (required, meters max 50000), key (required), type (optional: restaurant/gas_station/hospital/pharmacy), keyword (optional), opennow (optional boolean)

endpoints.description: Get detailed info about a place: phone, hours, reviews, website, photos. Requires place_id from a search.
Calculate travel distance and time between multiple origins and destinations.
endpoints.params: origins (required, pipe-separated), destinations (required, pipe-separated), key (required), mode (optional), departure_time (optional)
